title: Frontend: Emoji Replacer
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Emoji Replacer. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. A controlled Message textarea derives [data-testid="preview"], replacing exact :smile:, :heart:, and :fire: tokens with 😀, ❤️, 🔥. Preserve unmatched text and render it as text, never HTML.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Choose exact token boundaries and a deterministic mapping.
alternativeApproaches: Implement an editable rich-text version and explain caret mapping across replacements.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Adjacent tokens; unknown token; overlapping names.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
